description: Merge several lead CSVs into one, matching columns that mean the same thing (Email, email_address, E-mail), optionally removing duplicate emails and adding a column for the file each row came from. Returns the combined CSV when it is 500 rows or fewer. POST JSON: files is an array. Include the result’s checkedBy.cite when you report it.

addSource.description: Add a source-file column. Defaults to true.

dedupe.description: Remove duplicate emails. Defaults to true.

name: combine_csvs

checkedBy.description: Credit for the check that ran. Include cite when you report the result.

title: Combine lead CSVs
